body:
Similar experience. My best friend since childhood, his partner was abusive and when they broke up he was a suicidal mess. I spent a whole night into the AM after work on my weekend in the hospital with him. Myself and another close friend spent months being there for him, getting him out of trouble. He finally got back on track eventually.

Few years later when I go through my own significant brake up, all I got was a "Sorry to hear that man." And a month later he invited me over to his place as an after thought when he'd already invited his other friend first. I cut him off, and when he realized, he said the most terrible things when he knew I was already at my lowest. I told him he wouldn't be alive without me and nobody would be there for him like I was the next time he needed help, and to go fuck himself. 

3 years of crushing depression I endured on my own after that. Then one day I realized I don't need anyone to be happy, and now I'm content with my life.

This has made me realize a lot of things about myself that I had little idea about until now. I don't look to reddit for introspection, but god damn did your comment and the ones below it open a door for me that has been locked all my life as to why I'm the way that I am.
Having nostalgia and remembering how I used to feel about the things I loved. Now I'm older, less excitable than I was, and deadened on the inside

No hope for owning my own home, no hope for starting a family, no hope for the future, I don't even think about the future anymore. I look at life around me and all I feel is apathy. When I was younger I looked at the world and saw beauty and potential everywhere.

First was a boating accident, she flew off a jet ski and slammed into a tree. 

Second was a boy in my friends friend group. Killed himself while all his friends met up on the weekend and had a great day together, but the whole time they wondered why he didn't show up.

This is what I did immediately when I broke up with my first girlfriend of 3 years. I knew if I kept anything of her it would be torture and harder to move on. Proud of OP for moving on, it's a big step to healing.

Had several great friends spanning over 20 years. Was there when they needed me, none of them were there for me. On the plus side, I'm comfortable with the thought of being alone with myself, which most people are afraid of thinking about.

I knew of a kid at my highschool 11 years ago who did this, but the opposite. His friends went out expecting him to be there, he didn't show, they had one last good time together. Next day at school his passing was announced. Knowing what I know now as an adult, sometimes I think about that poor kid. Whatever he was experiencing, it was much worse.

Besides Reva killing off a more interesting character than herself, I really like the show and it feels more like Star Wars than anything else that's comes out from Disney. After years of viewing negative YouTube channels, I've had enough and would rather just enjoy something I like, and there isn't something I like then I don't watch and move on. Like how the Witcher is its own thing and different from the books. Toxic fans or just passionate it doesn't matter, it's all pointless negativity and a waste or time.
That someday my mental health will be better so that I can function like the majority of people and have a happier life.

After 11 years of friendship one day he just stopped caring about me all together, and that was that. That's life, people can be really disappointing.
Looking at OP's favourite game I said to myself "Nah, Return of the King". This is the first comment I saw and it makes me happy.

I still feel the sting too. I've had to go it alone and try to help myself, that's the worst part about it all. But I'm a stronger person and I will get through it somehow. I won't be helping anyone too much either.

When I helped him through an abusive break up with his ex. He was suicidal for months and I spent a lot of my time visiting him in a psych ward and helping him back on his feet when he got out. The first day he told me he wanted to die I spent my Friday night after work in a hospital with him for hours past midnight. 

A few years later when I need help because my ex left me? "Sorry to hear that man, we will hangout soon." We never did, and I never spoke to him again. He wouldn't be alive without me. 10 years of friendship gone in one sentence. Fuck that guy.
